related.title: 雙循環地熱發電系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「抑垢劑的加藥量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；雙循環地熱發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Dosing of scale inhibitor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦臺灣地熱的重新起步：雙循環發電、碳酸鈣結垢、容量因數、廠用電與抑垢加藥；雙循環地熱發電系統則以用七十幾度的溫水發電：冷源的重要、工質壓力比、工質流量、泵功與取代的柴油為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on taiwan's fresh start in geothermal: binary generation, calcium carbonate scaling, capacity factor, auxiliary power and inhibitor dosing; Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems centres on generating from water at seventy-odd degrees: the cold sink, working-fluid pressure ratio, fluid flow, pump work and diesel displaced, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱源溫度與效率上限」與「熱源溫度與效率上限」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「氣冷與廠用電」的模型移到雙循環地熱發電系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「工質泵的耗功」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" and "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling".
Move the model of "Air cooling and auxiliary power" to Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Work of the feed pump", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「抑垢劑的加藥量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；雙循環地熱發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Dosing of scale inhibitor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems must be respecified.

related.title: 地熱井完整性監測
related.transfer: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「抑垢劑的加藥量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；地熱井完整性監測的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Dosing of scale inhibitor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Geothermal Well Integrity Monitoring must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦臺灣地熱的重新起步：雙循環發電、碳酸鈣結垢、容量因數、廠用電與抑垢加藥；地熱井完整性監測則以看不見的井身出了什麼事：熱伸長、環空升壓、剩餘壁厚、溫度測井與熱循環為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on taiwan's fresh start in geothermal: binary generation, calcium carbonate scaling, capacity factor, auxiliary power and inhibitor dosing; Geothermal Well Integrity Monitoring centres on what is happening to a well nobody can see: thermal growth, annular pressure, remaining wall, temperature logs and thermal cycles, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱源溫度與效率上限」與「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「氣冷與廠用電」的模型移到地熱井完整性監測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「溫度測井與冷水入侵」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" and "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth".
Move the model of "Air cooling and auxiliary power" to Geothermal Well Integrity Monitoring, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Temperature logs and cold-water entry", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「抑垢劑的加藥量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；地熱井完整性監測的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Dosing of scale inhibitor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Geothermal Well Integrity Monitoring must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 宜蘭清水地熱發電廠
history.text: 1981 年先導電廠開始發電；1993 年先導電廠停止運轉；2021 年新的雙循環電廠商轉；2023 年宜蘭與新北的其他地熱電廠相繼併網。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1981: The pilot plant began generating. 1993: The pilot plant stopped. 2021: The new binary plant entered commercial operation. 2023: Other geothermal plants in Yilan and New Taipei were connected. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
